baselineBuild.scope: Release Rostrum target built from baseline library source; new font probe compiled with unchanged baseline InstalledFonts. Candidate preparation was implemented after this binary was built.

scope: Release font-registration probe; candidate file discovery is injected. Two fresh production sessions per process include file reads, validation and registration. Stage timings exclude fixture authoring, rendering and artifact writes; process timings and lifetime peak RSS include all of them. OS lookup, WebKit and UI are not measured. Input hashing and warmups can warm filesystem caches. Binary hashes identify measured builds; source revision alone does not establish binary provenance.
